Akshata Jadhav 8779962213 | akshataaj8956@gmail.com | Thane, Maharashtra | https://www.linkedin.com/in/akshata~jadhav

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Financial Operations professional with 2+ years of experience in Asset Servicing, specializing in cash and position reconciliation, dividend and interest income processing, income accrual reconciliation, break investigation, and financial reporting. Experienced in resolving reconciliation exceptions, collaborating with global stakeholders, and ensuring accurate and timely processing of income-related events while meeting SLA and operational deadlines. Strong knowledge of trade lifecycle, corporate actions, and securities operations with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

SKILLS AND INTEREST

Domain Expertise: Asset Servicing, Corporate Action, Trade Life Cycle, Financial Analysis, Reconciliation, Derivatives, Income Processing

Tools & Software: MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook), Bloomberg, DTCC, Bancs.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Financial Associate 2 State Street, Mumbai Cash Reconciliation

07/2023 - 05/2025

Performed daily reconciliation of dividend and interest payments of corporate action events between



custodian and client records, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution of discrepancies. Investigated and resolved high value cash breaks by performing detailed root cause investigation and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.

Performed reconciliation for Tax and FX settlement breaks by analyzing transaction data, validating payment details, and coordinating with internal teams to resolve exceptions.

Monitored aged reconciliation breaks and ensured timely resolution in accordance with client SLAs and operational procedures.

Supported processing and reconciliation of corporate action income events, including dividend and interest payments. Addressed client queries by providing investigation updates and resolution within agreed turnaround times.

Consultant BCT Consulting (On Contract) J.P. Morgan Chase, Mumbai (Client)

01/2026 – 07/2026

Prepared and delivered daily and weekly reports covering cash and position reconciliation breaks across investment banking operations teams. Collected and validated data from multiple sources to ensure accurate and timely reporting.

Reviewed SWIFT corporate action messages (MT564, MT566, and MT568) to verify event details, identify outstanding reconciliation breaks, and support accurate reporting.

Compared SWIFT message details with reconciliation reports and internal systems to investigate discrepancies and determine the status of outstanding breaks.

Coordinated with internal operations teams to validate data and resolve reporting discrepancies before final report distribution.

Maintained reporting documentation and supported daily operational reporting by ensuring data accuracy and completeness.

Developed a good understanding of the trade lifecycle and corporate action process through daily reporting and reconciliation activities.

KEY PROJECTS Client On boarding

Contributed to the successful onboarding of a sensitive client by supporting reconciliation activities and



ensuring a smooth transition into daily operations. Investigated outstanding DTM and Abandoned Property breaks by analyzing backend data and supporting the concerned team with accurate information for resolution.

EDUCATION Master’s in Business Administration [Finance] Dr. V N Bedeker Institute of Management Studies, Mumbai University

Bachelor of Commerce [Accounting] Dr. N G Bedekar College of Commerce, Mumbai University

CERTIFICATIONS MS CIT | Tally ERP9 |

AWARDS

Received Bravo Award for outstanding performance and quality delivery. • Recognized by the Onshore team for successfully clearing aged reconciliation breaks. • Awarded Titan of the Month based on monthly performance.

01/2022 – 12/2025

06/2018 – 05/2021
